QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Unidentified Walking Object
QuestInfo.0: It just so happened that Mayor Icebyrd Slimm had also been investigating these very same intruders. Find out what information he's gathered so far.
QuestInfo.1: Mayor Icebyrd Slimm asks you to assist Professor Foxwit, who's currently investigating seismic waves. Go see if the professor has discovered anything interesting.
QuestInfo.2: You touched base with Professor Foxwit for the first time in quite a while.

npc.0: I'm sure Professor Foxwit is dying to hear what you uncovered. You ought to check in with him.
